title: [C16T4] - Recycling plastic bottles
prompt: The diagram shows the process for recycling plastic bottles. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the process of recycling plastic bottles into new products.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: The process undergoes 9 stages, beginning with the initial stage where plastic bottles are collected in large containers, and ending with the manufacturing of final products such as new bottles, clothing, and household items.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: In the first stages of the process, plastic bottles are collected in large wheeled containers before being transported to a recycling center by trucks. At the center, the materials are sorted to remove any unsuitable items. Following this, the sorted bottles are compressed into compact blocks, which are then crushed into smaller pieces.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: The latter stages of the process involve several transformations. First, the crushed pieces are washed before being processed into plastic pellets. After that, these pellets are then heated to be converted into raw material. Finally, this raw material is manufactured into various new products, including t-shirts, plastic bottles, and other items.
